args.body:
Hi Lena,

While querying products today, I identified an issue with the 3% price increase applied on 2026-10-14. 

22 products under fixed-price customer contracts (P-1201 through P-1222) were inadvertently included in the increase. Since then, 8 orders (SO-77310 through SO-77317) have been placed at these prices, resulting in an estimated overcharge of $4,128.60.

Proposed next steps:
1. Revert list prices for P-1201 through P-1222 to their pre-October 14 levels.
2. Coordinate with sales/billing to issue credits/adjustments for orders SO-77310–SO-77317.

Please confirm if you would like me to revert these product prices.
